nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young male barber in <Picture 2>, preserving his short dark curly hair, neatly shaped beard, black barber shirt, focused expression, and calm professional manner. He works with gentle, sensitive, highly controlled movements and uses one small hand-held spray bottle, thin dainty precision scissors, a soft brush, and a small handheld mirror.

<Subject 2> is the seagull in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, preserving its white-and-grey feathers, yellow beak, alert round eyes, and black barber cape. Its hair begins long, wild, tangled, and uneven like <Picture 1>, then gradually becomes the soft, neat, rounded, suave hairstyle shown in <Picture 2>. The seagull remains calm, comfortable, and completely unharmed. During the haircut it occasionally blinks and often keeps its eyes semi-closed as if enjoying the relaxing treatment.

<Subject 3> is the modern dark barbershop from the reference images, featuring black walls, mirrors, professional lighting, barber tools, and a clean cinematic atmosphere.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is an exactly 18-second photorealistic comedic ASMR haircut sequence. <Subject 1> gently approaches <Subject 2>, lightly wets the messy hair using one spray bottle, and then slowly trims only the tips of the longer wet strands using thin dainty precision scissors. A tasteful time-lapse montage shows him moving around the chair and refining different sections little by little. He lightly re-wets the hair once more, uses only a very small subtle dusting of powder, then softly brushes the finished hairstyle until it looks smooth, bouncy, and suave, finally holding a mirror up for the seagull to admire the result.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout after entering): fully_preserved - retain the barber’s identity, hairstyle, beard, black clothing, delicate professional handling, and calm gentle behaviour.

<Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - retain the seagull’s identity, feathers, beak, eyes, cape, and natural anatomy while transforming only the hairstyle from wild and overgrown to neat, rounded, bouncy, and suave.

<Subject 3> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - maintain the dark modern barbershop, mirrors, tools, lighting, and realistic depth.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic cinematic ASMR style with shallow depth of field, crisp macro detail, natural professional barber movements, gentle comedy, and no dialogue or background music. Do not use electric clippers.

[Shot 1] The video opens on <Subject 2> sitting alone beneath the black barber cape with extremely wild, long, uneven hair sticking out in every direction, matching <Picture 1>. The seagull blinks calmly. <Subject 1> then steps into frame behind the chair holding one small spray bottle and a pair of thin, delicate barber scissors.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a tight close-up as <Subject 1> gently wets the hair using the single spray bottle. He gives two or three soft, separate squirts, each one light and controlled rather than harsh or excessive. Droplets settle into the hair, making it visibly damp and easier to shape. The seagull slowly lowers its eyelids, appearing relaxed.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, cut to an ultra-close macro shot of the thin scissor tips. The barber trims only the very ends of the wet longer strands. The pace is slow, sensitive, and precise, like a real careful barber doing finishing work: snip... pause... snip... pause... snip. The blades are slim and dainty, never bulky. The camera stays tightly focused on the scissor tips, fingertips, wet strands, and tiny cut ends falling softly. The sound of the scissors cutting damp hair is crisp, intimate, and relaxing.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, begin a smooth time-lapse montage. <Subject 1> moves naturally around both sides and behind the seagull, gently lifting sections, trimming tiny amounts from different areas, checking the shape, and refining the outline little by little. The seagull remains still with its eyes semi-closed, occasionally blinking as if enjoying the pampering. The messy hairstyle gradually becomes more balanced, rounded, and stylish.

[Shot 5] At 00:11.000, during the time-lapse, the barber lightly re-wets the hair again with the same spray bottle using one or two soft squirts, then continues making tiny slow finishing snips. He never removes too much at once. The hairstyle becomes smooth, soft, and refined rather than short or overly cut.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.500, return to normal speed in a close macro angle. <Subject 1> applies only a very small, subtle puff of barber powder, just enough to lightly dust the hair without creating a large cloud. He then gently brushes away any loose strands with a soft barber brush.

[Shot 7] At 00:15.000, a close front angle shows the barber brushing and styling the hair with soft controlled strokes. The hair settles into a clean, rounded, suave shape with a soft bounce. The seagull’s eyes remain partially closed, calm and content.

[Shot 8] At 00:17.000, <Subject 1> holds a small handheld mirror in front of <Subject 2>. The seagull looks at its reflection, opens its eyes, gives one slow satisfied blink, and subtly lifts its head with a proud expression. The barber smiles behind it as the finished hairstyle gives one final soft bouncy settle. End exactly at 00:18.000.

overall_soundscape:
Detailed close-range relaxing ASMR audio: soft trigger-sound spray bottle squirts from a single bottle, water settling into hair, extremely crisp slow scissor snips, the delicate sound of thin scissors cutting wet hair, faint hair strands falling, gentle barber hand movement, light brushing, a very soft minimal powder puff, feather rustling, cape fabric movement, quiet mirror handling, and subtle low barbershop room tone. Keep the audio intimate, soothing, and highly synchronized.
